priorityList: Avatar just before or with Colossus Smash
Mortal Strike with two stacks of Executioner's Precision
Execute with more than 40 Rage or Sudden Death
Cast Avatar on cooldown, ideally synchronized with Colossus Smash.
Cast Colossus Smash on cooldown to maintain the physical damage vulnerability on the target.
Cast Execute whenever it is available, either through the target being below 35% health or Sudden Death procs.
Cast Bladestorm on cooldown to trigger Slayer's Strike and generate high burst damage.
Cast Mortal Strike if you have 2 stacks of Martial Prowess.
Cast Overpower to generate stacks of Martial Prowess and avoid capping charges.
Cast Mortal Strike on cooldown to maintain Deep Wounds and consume Martial Prowess stacks.
Cast Thunder Clap to apply or refresh Rend if it is not currently active on the target.
Cast Slam as a filler ability if you have more than 60 Rage and all other priority abilities are on cooldown.
